summary: Great Elm Capital Corp. filed an 8-K announcing its exercise of an optional redemption of $6.5 million aggregate principal amount of its 8.50% Notes due 2029. The redemption will occur on August 19, 2026 at 100% of principal plus accrued interest through the redemption date, representing a typical make-whole call. The board made no recommendation; no advisor was named. The mechanics follow the Indenture dated September 18, 2017 and the Sixth Supplemental Indenture. The note has no premium over par. What to watch: the reduced outstanding principal after redemption and any impact on the issuer's leverage metrics.
